question.question_text: A block of mass 10 kg rests on a frictionless plane inclined at an angle of 30 degrees to the horizontal. Calculate the normal reaction force exerted by the plane on the block (take g = 9.8 m/s^2).
question.expected_physics_summary: A block of mass {mass} kg rests on a frictionless plane inclined at an angle of {theta} degrees to the horizontal. Calculate the normal reaction force exerted by the plane on the block (take g = 9.8 m/s^2).

student_submission.working_steps:
Resolving weight perpendicular to incline: N = mg * cos(theta)
N = 10 * 9.8 * cos(30 deg) = 98.0 * 0.866 = 84.87 N

ground_truth.diagnostic_rationale: Accurate free-body diagram resolution along the normal axis.
